chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the man who strikes the woman, so she drops the nutfah (seed/embryo). He (peace be upon him) said: 'Upon him is twenty dinars.' I said: 'He hits her and she drops the 'alaqah (clot)?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Upon him is forty dinars.' I said: 'So he hits her and she drops the mudghah (lump of flesh)?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Upon him is sixty dinars.' I said: 'So he hits her and she drops it, and bones have formed upon it?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Upon him is the complete diyyah (blood money), and by this Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) judged.'

I said: 'So what is the description of the creation of the nutfah by which it is recognized?' He said: 'The nutfah is white, like thick phlegm. It remains in the womb. When forty days pass over it, then it becomes an 'alaqah (clot).' I said: 'So what is the description of the creation of the 'alaqah by which it is recognized?' He said: 'It is a clot like the clot of coagulated blood, solidified. It remains in the womb after its conversion from the nutfah for forty days, then it becomes a mudghah (lump of flesh).'

I said: 'So what is the description of the mudghah and its creation by which it is recognized?' He said: 'It is a lump of red flesh in which are green veins, entangled. Then it becomes bones.' I said: 'So what is the description of its creation when it is bones?' He said: 'When it is bones, the hearing and sight are formed for it, and its limbs are arranged. So when it is like that, then regarding it is the complete diyyah.'

key_terms.الدِّيَة: Blood money or compensation for injury/death
key_terms.النُّطْفَة: Seed/embryo, the first stage of development
key_terms.الْعَلَقَة: Clot, the second stage of development
key_terms.الْمُضْغَة: Lump of flesh, the third stage of development

ai.seo_question: What is the blood money for miscarriage at different stages of fetal development in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes a graded system of financial compensation (diyyah) for miscarriage caused by physical trauma, linking specific monetary penalties to embryological stages as defined by Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). It notably anchors this legal framework in the precedent of Amir al-Mu'minin (Ali ibn Abi Talib), thereby validating the detailed physical descriptions of the nutfah, alaqah, mudghah, and 'izam as criteria for determining fetal viability and compensation value in Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about the man who struck the woman, so she dropped the seed. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon him is twenty Dinars’. So I said, ‘He hits her and she drops the clot?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon him is forty Dinars’. I said, ‘So he hits her, and she drops the lump?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon his is sixty Dinars’. I said, ‘So he hits her, she drops it, and bones had occurred upon it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon him is the complete wergild, and it is by this that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged’.

I said, ‘So what is the description of the creation of the seed which it is recognised by?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The seed happens to be white, like the thick phlegm. So it remains in the womb. When forty days pass over it, then it becomes a clot’. I said, ‘So what is the description of the creation of the clot which it is recognised by?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is a clot like the clot of the coagulated blood, solidified, remaining in the womb after its conversion from the seed, for forty days, then it becomes a lump’.

I said, ‘So what is the description of the lump and its creation which it is recognised by?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is a lump of red flesh in which are green veins, entangled. Then it becomes bones’. I said, ‘So what is the description of its creation when it was bones?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it was bones, there are formed limbs for it, the hearing, and the sight, and arrangement of its limbs. So when it was like that, so regarding it is the complete wergild’.
